title: Compatible valuation-ring isomorphisms preserve normalized orders
statement: Let K, E and L be fields with K-algebra structures on E and L. Let e : E ≃ₐ[K] L, let v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E and w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L, and let r : v.toValuationSubring ≃ₐ[K] w.toValuationSubring. Suppose that (r a : L) = e (a : E) for every a in v.toValuationSubring. Then for every nonzero f ∈ E, w.ord (e f) = v.ord f. No characteristic, principal-divisor, finite-dimensionality, or finite-residue hypothesis is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] (e : E ≃ₐ[K] L) (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L) (r : v.toValuationSubring ≃ₐ[K] w.toValuationSubring), (∀ a : v.toValuationSubring, (r a : L) = e (a : E)) → ∀ f : E, f ≠ 0 → w.ord (e f) = v.ord f
